methods.description: Write a nonzero whole number as a fraction over1, or change a mixed number to an improper fraction, then swap numerator and denominator. A fraction is swapped directly; a denominator1 result is a whole number.

Use the fact that reciprocal numbers multiply to1 to find a missing factor, recover a number from its given reciprocal, or recognise the positive self-reciprocal number. Swap the given fractional form and check its product; do not use a quadratic-solving method.
